summary.headline: 🚨 FRONTEND ENGINEER WITH QA DNA — BUILDS IT RIGHT THE FIRST TIME
summary.subheadline: 6 years of audit precision now engineering high-quality React applications.
body: Most developers write code that works. Devanshu writes code that survives.
With 6 years of experience in high-stakes quality auditing, Devanshu brings a rare edge: the ability to predict, prevent, and eliminate failure points before they reach users.

Now specializing in React.js and modern frontend architecture, he builds scalable, responsive, and production-ready interfaces with a strong focus on performance, maintainability, and user experience.

career_story.title: The Unfair Advantage
career_story.subtitle: Built on 6 years of breaking systems before building them.
career_story.content: Before writing a single line of frontend code, Devanshu spent years identifying where systems fail—data mismatches, edge cases, and process breakdowns. That experience now translates into a powerful engineering mindset: anticipating bugs before they happen. Today, every component and interaction is built with precision and reliability.

achievements: Built and deployed responsive, production-grade interfaces using React.js and Tailwind CSS.
Designed reusable component architecture, reducing development redundancy and improving scalability.
Integrated REST APIs with Axios, enabling real-time, dynamic UI updates.
Collaborated with design teams to deliver pixel-perfect UI implementations.
Improved application performance and user experience through clean code and optimization techniques.
experience.impact: Delivered faster, more reliable UI systems with improved maintainability and performance.

achievements: Audited high-volume financial and insurance data with strict compliance standards.
Maintained high accuracy rates while processing large datasets.
Identified recurring error patterns and helped improve operational processes.
Generated reports and insights using Excel to optimize workflows.
experience.impact: Built a deep foundation in accuracy, compliance, and failure detection—now applied to frontend engineering.

projects.title: TodoWala — High-Performance Task Engine
projects.description: A real-time, feature-rich task management system designed for speed, usability, and zero-friction interaction.
projects.screenshot_caption: Drag-and-drop task manager with dark mode and real-time updates
highlights: Real-time countdown timers with dynamic updates
Custom LocalStorage hook for persistent state

narrative.problem: Most task managers are slow, overloaded, and disrupt user flow.
narrative.analysis: Focused on eliminating latency and ensuring instant UI feedback using a local-first approach.
narrative.solution: Engineered a high-performance React application with near-instant interactions and persistent state.

projects.impact: Created a fast, reliable productivity tool that maintains user flow without performance bottlenecks.

projects.title: Chef Claude — AI Recipe Generator
projects.description: An intelligent recipe generator that suggests personalized dishes based on available ingredients using AI.
projects.screenshot_caption: AI-generated recipe based on user-selected ingredients
highlights: AI-generated recipes based on user input

narrative.problem: Users often struggle to decide what to cook with limited ingredients available at home.
narrative.analysis: Identified the need for a smart system that can interpret user input and generate useful, contextual outputs using AI.
narrative.solution: Built a React-based interface where users input ingredients, and upon reaching a minimum threshold, an AI API generates a structured recipe including preparation steps and ingredients.

projects.impact: Demonstrated practical AI integration in frontend applications, improving user decision-making and showcasing real-world problem solving.
